cards.front: What key point should you remember from Data Handling and Presentation?
cards.back: 4 Data Handling and Presentation If you ask your classmates about their favourite colours, you will get a list of colours.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Data Handling and Presentation?
cards.back: Similarly, if you measure the weight of each student in your class, you would get a collection of measures of weight—again data.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Data Handling and Presentation?
cards.back: Any collection of facts, numbers, measures, observations or other descriptions of things that convey information about those things is called data.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Data Handling and Presentation?
cards.back: We constantly see large amounts of data presented to us in new and interesting ways.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Data Handling and Presentation?
cards.back: In this chapter, we will explore some of the ways that data is presented, and how we can use some of those ways to correctly display, interpret and make inferences from such data!
